question: With different speakers in the shared and microphone lanes, does raising the synthetically quiet microphone lane recover its own clean-reference words without materially degrading the shared lane?
scope: Diagnostic prototype only. It does not certify G3, select a production mixer policy, or set a Defect C warning threshold.

production_path.rule: both lanes receive -6 dB headroom then the production soft limiter

fixture.references: transcribe each unattenuated lane cleanly with the same model before scoring its mixed result

candidates.runner_policy_label: current (equal gain, mic left 15 dB down)
candidates.description: Current equal-gain mixer; microphone remains 15 dB below its clean source.

candidates.runner_policy_label: matched (mic scaled to the shared lane's rms)
candidates.description: Scale the attenuated microphone by shared RMS divided by attenuated microphone RMS.
Raise the attenuated microphone by 7.5 dB, half of the declared disparity.

metrics.primary: Per-lane recall: fraction of normalized tokens in one lane's clean transcript that occur in the mixed transcript; report microphone and shared values separately.
secondary: Quiet-microphone word error rate against its own clean reference, using token Levenshtein distance divided by reference-token count.
Quiet-microphone missing-word count: reference-token count minus LCS length against the mixed transcript.
Output limited-sample fraction from the faithful production-mixer copy.

candidate_is_rejected_if: microphone recall improves by less than 0.05 absolute
shared-lane recall decreases by more than 0.05 absolute
quiet-microphone word error rate improves by less than 0.05 absolute
quiet-microphone missing-word count does not strictly decrease
decision_rule.selection_among_eligible_candidates: Choose the largest microphone-recall improvement. If results are within 0.005 absolute, choose the lower microphone gain.
decision_rule.if_no_candidate_is_eligible: Retain identity; do not propose normalization, AGC, or a fixed offset.
decision_rule.interpretation_limit: A result removes or confirms the prior same-playback rejection only. One corpus, synthetic attenuation, and same-model references cannot authorize a production change or a Defect C threshold.
